name: Supervisor Dashboard — Bulk reject items with reason modal
description: Supervisor logs in with test_supervisor, selects TS-ITEM-002, enters rejection reason in the modal, and rejects it back to counter.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_supervisor into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Locate the item TS-ITEM-002 in the supervisor cartable and select its checkbox
Click the reject button labelled رد موارد انتخابی to open the rejection modal
Enter مغایرت در شمارش اولیه، بازشماری شود into the rejection reason textarea
Click the confirm rejection button in the modal
Verify that the item TS-ITEM-002 is rejected and no longer pending in supervisor list
